findings: C: 254 full-image descriptor inliers, only41 within both manual key ROIs; ROI sensitivity yields92/86/91 inliers. Background/shared scene can dominate full-image matching.
A and B: no finite fit in all three native ROI scopes. Failure to match cannot distinguish preserved overall key shape from known major deformation.
Different key/mug targets: small fitted sets exist, but3 descriptor inliers collapse to2 distinct sites in each native ROI. A finite similarity fit alone cannot prove object identity.
C mask Dice varies0.2539..0.8418, A0.1935..0.8424, B0.3564..0.7272 across predeclared saturation thresholds. Score ordering changes; no threshold selected after labels.
Largest low-saturation component omits major key regions; higher saturation may select table and touch ROI boundary. No mask certified as complete object.
Mug recolor ROI inliers34/37/34: alignment evidence, no per-contact/hole verification and no structurally malformed-mug negative.
decision: Do not integrate SIFT match counts or HSV mask Dice as admission/identity gates. Retain uncertainty and existing human judgments.
next_task: Prepare explicit complete-object masks and component landmarks, with independent visual review and allowed pose/projection changes stated before measuring. Start with existing A/B/C and mug positives; add reviewed structural negatives before calibration. No automatic admission or new weights without scope.
